The most common examples of continuous media are audio and motion video.'；被定义项为术语，句中小写 must 用于界定概念内涵而非施加实现义务，故 strength=unknown。

review_note: 第872–874行 'However, exploiting the case sensitivity of mailbox local-parts impedes interoperability and is discouraged.'；'is discouraged' 非 BCP14 关键词（非大写 SHOULD NOT），按硬规则①记 unknown，按硬规则③视为具规范意味的劝阻，polarity=negative。

subject: mailbox 的域部分（mailbox domains）
object: 大小写（不区分，因遵循 DNS 规则）
review_note: 第874–875行 'Mailbox domains follow normal DNS rules and are hence not case sensitive.'；属语义说明（域部分大小写不敏感及其理由），无约束力。

★ 审核意见: 第903–906行 'An originating SMTP client that has not successfully negotiated an appropriate extension with a particular server ... MUST NOT transmit messages with information in the high-order bit of octets' 为 MUST NOT；第906–908行 'receiving SMTP servers MAY clear the high-order bit or reject the message as invalid' 为 MAY；第908–911行 'a relay SMTP SHOULD assume that the message content it has received is valid and ... relay it without inspecting that content' 为 SHOULD；第914–915行 'Delivery SMTP systems MAY reject such messages, or return them as undeliverable' 为 MAY；第915–918行 'a sending SMTP system is not permitted to send envelope commands in any character set other than US-ASCII' 为陈述式禁令；第918–919行 'Receiving systems SHOULD reject such commands, normally using "500 syntax error - invalid character" replies' 为 SHOULD。片段以「未扩展的 SMTP 只提供 7 位传输」为前提（891–894 行在片段外），故判跨句。
subject: 尚未与特定服务器成功协商适当扩展的发起方 SMTP 客户端
object: 在八位组最高位（high-order bit）携带信息的消息
condition: 该客户端未与特定服务器成功协商适当的扩展（has not successfully negotiated an appropriate extension）
review_note: 第903–906行 'An originating SMTP client that has not successfully negotiated an appropriate extension with a particular server (see the next paragraph) MUST NOT transmit messages with information in the high-order bit of octets.'；MUST NOT ? strength=MUST、polarity=negative；主体限定语即 condition。

subject: 接收方 SMTP 服务器
object: 八位组最高位（清除之），或将消息作为无效拒绝
condition: 若此类消息被违反上述规则地发送（If such messages are transmitted in violation of this rule）
review_note: 第906–908行 'If such messages are transmitted in violation of this rule, receiving SMTP servers MAY clear the high-order bit or reject the message as invalid.'；MAY 给出两种可选处置，合并为一条。

subject: 中继型 SMTP（relay SMTP）
object: 所收到的消息内容为有效，并在信封允许时不经检查地转发
condition: 信封（envelope）允许这样做（assuming that the envelope permits doing so）
review_note: 第908–911行 'In general, a relay SMTP SHOULD assume that the message content it has received is valid and, assuming that the envelope permits doing so, relay it without inspecting that content.'；SHOULD，'In general' 表明为一般性推荐。

subject: 投递型 SMTP 系统（Delivery SMTP systems）
object: 此类消息（而非投递它们）
review_note: 第914–915行 'Delivery SMTP systems MAY reject such messages, or return them as undeliverable, rather than deliver them.'；MAY 两选项合并；'rather than deliver' 是对默认投递的替代，故 polarity 仍为 positive（行为被许可）。

subject: 发送方 SMTP 系统（a sending SMTP system）
object: 以 US-ASCII 之外字符集表示的信封命令
condition: 缺少服务器提供且明确允许的扩展时（In the absence of a server-offered extension explicitly permitting it）
review_note: 第915–918行 'In the absence of a server-offered extension explicitly permitting it, a sending SMTP system is not permitted to send envelope commands in any character set other than US-ASCII.'；'is not permitted to' 为陈述式禁令，无 BCP14 关键词，按硬规则③标注、强度记 unknown。

subject: 接收方系统（Receiving systems）
object: 此类（非 US-ASCII 信封）命令，通常以 '500 syntax error - invalid character' 回复
review_note: 第918–919行 'Receiving systems SHOULD reject such commands, normally using "500 syntax error - invalid character" replies.'；SHOULD，'normally' 使回复文案为惯常做法而非强制，已写入 object 限定。

★ 审核意见: 第921–923行 '8-bit message content transmission MAY be requested of the server by a client using extended SMTP facilities, notably the 8BITMIME extension' 为 MAY；第923–924行 '8BITMIME SHOULD be supported by SMTP servers' 为 SHOULD；第924–926行 'it MUST NOT be construed as authorization to transmit unrestricted 8-bit material, nor does 8BITMIME authorize transmission of any envelope material in other than ASCII' 为 MUST NOT；第926–929行 '8BITMIME MUST NOT be requested by senders for material with the high bit on that is not in MIME format with an appropriate content-transfer encoding; servers MAY reject such messages' 含 MUST NOT 与 MAY 两条。均在片段内，判否跨句。
subject: 客户端
object: 8 位消息内容传输（使用扩展 SMTP 设施，典型为 8BITMIME，RFC 1652）
review_note: 第921–923行 '8-bit message content transmission MAY be requested of the server by a client using extended SMTP facilities, notably the 8BITMIME extension, RFC 1652 [22].'；MAY 表许可。

subject: SMTP 服务器
object: 8BITMIME 扩展
review_note: 第923–924行 '8BITMIME SHOULD be supported by SMTP servers.'；SHOULD 为推荐强度。

subject: 8BITMIME 扩展
object: 传输不受限制的 8 位材料；以 ASCII 之外的形式传输任何信封材料
review_note: 第924–926行 'However, it MUST NOT be construed as authorization to transmit unrestricted 8-bit material, nor does 8BITMIME authorize transmission of any envelope material in other than ASCII.'；MUST NOT ? MUST + negative；后半句 'nor does 8BITMIME authorize' 为同义补充，并入同一条。

subject: 发送方（senders）
object: 8BITMIME，用于最高位为 1 且非 MIME 格式（或缺适当 content-transfer-encoding）的材料
condition: 该材料最高位为 1 且不处于带适当内容传输编码的 MIME 格式
review_note: 第926–928行 '8BITMIME MUST NOT be requested by senders for material with the high bit on that is not in MIME format with an appropriate content-transfer encoding'；MUST NOT ? MUST + negative；条件的两个合取项均来自该句。

subject: 服务器（servers）
object: 此类消息
review_note: 第928–929行 'servers MAY reject such messages.'；MAY 表许可，与前一 MUST NOT 为不同强度子句，故按粒度拆开。

★ 审核意见: 第243–245行 'This specification uses the Augmented Backus-Naur Form (ABNF) [RFC5234] notation for the formal definitions of the syntax of messages' 声明语法记法；第245–248行 'Characters will be specified either by a decimal value (e.g., the value %d65 for uppercase A and %d97 for lowercase A) or by a case-insensitive literal value enclosed in quotation marks (e.g., "A" for either uppercase or lowercase A)' 为字符表示法规定。属语法类（记法/字面量约定），ABNF 本体在 RFC 5234，故判「引用外部章节」。
subject: 本规范中报文语法的形式定义
object: ABNF（Augmented Backus-Naur Form，RFC 5234）记法
review_note: 第243–245行 'This specification uses the Augmented Backus-Naur Form (ABNF) [RFC5234] notation for the formal definitions of the syntax of messages.'；属记法约定（元语法），无数值强度。

subject: ABNF 中的字符表示
object: 十进制数值（如 %d65 表示大写 A、%d97 表示小写 A），或以引号包围的、大小写不敏感的字面量（如 "A" 表示大写或小写 a）
review_note: 第245–248行 'Characters will be specified either by a decimal value (e.g., the value %d65 for uppercase A and %d97 for lowercase A) or by a case-insensitive literal value enclosed in quotation marks (e.g., "A" for either uppercase or lowercase A).'；两种字面量写法及 %d65/%d97 示例均直接见于原文。

★ 审核意见: 第415–418行 'Some field bodies in this specification are defined simply as unstructured (which is specified in section 3.2.5 as any printable US-ASCII characters plus white space characters) with no further restrictions. These are referred to as unstructured field bodies' 给出术语定义与其字符集；第419–421行 'Semantically, unstructured field bodies are simply to be treated as a single line of characters with no further processing (except for folding and unfolding as described in section 2.2.3)' 给出处理语义与例外。字符集与 folding 规则分别指向 3.2.5 与 2.2.3，故判「引用外部章节」。
subject: unstructured field body（无结构字段体）
object: 任意可打印 US-ASCII 字符加空白字符，且无进一步限制
review_note: 第415–418行 'Some field bodies in this specification are defined simply as unstructured (which is specified in section 3.2.5 as any printable US-ASCII characters plus white space characters) with no further restrictions. These are referred to as unstructured field bodies.'；被定义项为字段体类型，字符集允许范围即其语法内容；细节来源为 3.2.5。

subject: unstructured field body
object: 单行字符，且不再作进一步处理
review_note: 第419–421行 'Semantically, unstructured field bodies are simply to be treated as a single line of characters with no further processing (except for folding and unfolding as described in section 2.2.3).'；属处理语义（无约束强度），例外为 folding/unfolding，已记入 exception。

★ 审核意见: 第425–429行 'Some field bodies in this specification have a syntax that is more restrictive than the unstructured field bodies described above. These are referred to as structured field bodies. Structured field bodies are sequences of specific lexical tokens as described in sections 3 and 4' 给出术语定义与构成方式；第429–433行 'Many of these tokens are allowed ... to be introduced or end with comments ... as well as the white space characters, and those white space characters are subject to folding and unfolding as described in section 2.2.3' 为构成细节；第433–434行 'Semantic analysis of structured field bodies is given along with their syntax' 说明语义与语法同处给出。依赖 sections 3/4 与 2.2.3，故判「引用外部章节」。
subject: structured field body（结构化字段体）
object: 由特定词法记号的序列构成、语法比 unstructured field body 更严格的字段体
review_note: 第425–429行 'Some field bodies in this specification have a syntax that is more restrictive than the unstructured field bodies described above. These are referred to as structured field bodies. Structured field bodies are sequences of specific lexical tokens as described in sections 3 and 4 of this specification.'；术语定义，无强度。

subject: 结构化字段体中的词法记号（tokens）
object: 注释（comments，按 3.2.2）与空白字符；这些空白字符受 folding/unfolding 约束（按 2.2.3）
condition: 按其语法允许时（according to their syntax）
review_note: 第429–433行 'Many of these tokens are allowed (according to their syntax) to be introduced or end with comments (as described in section 3.2.2) as well as the white space characters, and those white space characters are subject to folding and unfolding as described in section 2.2.3.'；属字段体的语法构成规定，细节依赖外部小节。

subject: structured field body 的语义分析
object: 其语法（即语义与语法在同一处描述）
review_note: 第433–434行 'Semantic analysis of structured field bodies is given along with their syntax.'；为文档组织方式的说明，属描述性语义，无约束力。

★ 审核意见: 第679–689行为 ABNF 产生式 'atext'：'atext = ALPHA / DIGIT / "!" / "#" / "$" / "%" / "&" / "'" / "*" / "+" / "-" / "/" / "=" / "?" / "^" / "_" / "`" / "{" / "|" / "}" / "~"'，并附注释 'Printable US-ASCII characters not including specials. Used for atoms.'。属单个产生式的语法定义，按粒度作 1 条；片段内自足，判否跨句。
subject: 产生式 atext
object: ALPHA / DIGIT，以及 ! # $ % & 撇号 * + - / = ? ^ _ ` { | } ~ 等可打印 US-ASCII 字符（即不含 specials 者），用于 atom
review_note: 第679–689行逐行列出 'atext = ALPHA / DIGIT / "!" / "#" / "$" / "%" / "&" / "'" / "*" / "+" / "-" / "/" / "=" / "?" / "^" / "_" / "`" / "{" / "|" / "}" / "~"' 及注释 'Printable US-ASCII characters not including specials. Used for atoms.'；条目按「每个产生式一条」处理，字符清单未逐字符拆分。

★ 审核意见: 第697–703行为 ABNF 产生式 'specials'：'specials = "(" / ")" / "<" / ">" / "[" / "]" / ":" / ";" / "@" / "\" / "," / "." / DQUOTE'，注释说明其为不出现在 atext 中的特殊字符。属单个产生式的语法定义，与 679–689 行的 atext 互补；片段内自足，判否跨句。
subject: 产生式 specials
object: 圆括号 ( )、尖括号 < >、方括号 [ ]、冒号、分号、@、反斜杠、逗号、句点，以及 DQUOTE
review_note: 第697–703行 'specials = "(" / ")" / "<" / ">" / "[" / "]" / ":" / ";" / "@" / "\" / "," / "." / DQUOTE' 及注释 'Special characters that do not appear in atext'；按「每个产生式一条」处理；为避免转义歧义，object 中以汉字名称列举字符。
